subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Valued Customer, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to London on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: ABC123 Departure: New York JFK Airport Arrival: London Heathrow Airport We look forward to welcoming you on board and wish you a pleasant journey. Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us. Safe travels! Best regards, XYZ Airlines
